Card Q&A.a: It refers to the suspended or unsuspended state of a card.

Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [When Digivolving] effect to suspend either my Digimon or my opponent's Digimon?
Can I use this card's [Main] effect to unsuspend either my Digimon or my opponent's Digimon?

DUAL Effect: ＜Use Req. ([TS] trait)＞ (Specified cards let you ignore color requirements.)
[Main] You may unsuspend 1 Digimon. Then, delete all of your opponent's unsuspended Digimon with the lowest DP.
DUAL Rule: ＜Arts Digivolve＞ (Instead of trashing after use, your cards may digivolve into this card without paying the cost.)
Effect: ＜Security A. +1＞ ＜Succession ([Bacchusmon])＞ (This Digimon gains all effects other than ＜Succession＞ on its topmost specified digivolution card.)
[When Digivolving] By suspending 1 Digimon, this Digimon may attack without suspending.
[When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with the same orientation as this Digimon.
